entry_state: The group profile binds legal-book identities, currency units, control intervals and immutable branches. Group publication preserves legal books and exact retry identity; corrected source evidence creates a new view without overwriting the old explanation. The next section examines why an eliminated intragroup loan can leave a real currency exposure.
exit_state: Eliminating an intragroup loan does not erase the currency exposure of the group's cash; settlement facts decide profit versus OCI. Eliminations require identified events and nonduplicated allocations. Hyperinflation restatement preserves monetary purchasing-power loss before translation. Exchangeability now requires currency direction,date and purpose rather than a quote alone.
findings: Ordinary and qualifying net-investment loan cases both close at212 but split exchange result10 between profit andOCI differently; no cash receipt occurred.
A receivable and payable of equal100 cannot be eliminated unless they identify the same transaction. The partial external inventory sale produces groupprofit36 and remaininginventory36.
Restating monetary cash and debt would conceal the purchasing-power loss10. The turnover variant explicitly splits exposure intervals instead of applying the constant-exposure formula.
